{{Quote|Sergeant Swift!'' Take your boys and crack it open.''"<br />"''Yes, sir! Brace of ''thermal detonators'' should do the trick.|italics=0|Commander Cody and Sergeant Swift|<ref name="Deception" />}}
'''Swift''' was a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] who fought in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Sometime between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], they participated in a [[Siege of Tambor Deep Space Centre|raid]] on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Tambor Deep Space Centre]]. During the battle, they led a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]] in an attempt to break into a bunker, wherein the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] chief [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]], [[Gorgol/Legends|Gorgol the Handy]], was hiding. In response, Gorgol activated hidden [[Autoturret/Legends|defense turrets]], which [[Death/Legends|eliminated]] Swift and their entire squad.

==Biography==
===Serving the Republic===
{{Quote|''You heard the commander! Walkers to sprint&mdash;''Move out!|italics=0|Swift|<ref name="Deception" />}}
Swift<ref name="Deception" /> was created on<ref name="Databank" /> the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Kamino system/Legends|Kamino system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] as a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="Databank" /> They served as a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone sergeant]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Deception" /> Sometime between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Death" /> under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commanders]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]], Swift participated in a [[Siege of Tambor Deep Space Centre|raid]] on the [[Tambor Deep Space Centre]], a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] workshop<ref name="Deception" /> located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> that served as a [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] repair facility for the Separatists.<ref name="Deception" />

[[File:MoveOut-TheDroidDeception.png|thumb|left|250px|Swift orders their squadron to move out.]]
During the raid, Windu lamented the difficulty of breaching a security complex on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], which was reinforced with [[Laminasteel/Legends|laminasteel]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Cody rebuked the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] concerns and confidently ordered Swift to rally their [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] and break the bunker open with a forceful frontal attack. The [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] gave Cody an affirmative and suggested that two [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] would be sufficient. Kenobi expressed concern over the tactic, but Cody remained steadfast. Swift ordered their squadron of eight other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to prove the clone commander correct and gave the command to set the [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]] to sprint.<ref name="Deception" />

===Victim to folly===
{{Quote|Swift! No!|italics=0|Commander Cody, witnessing Swift's death|<ref name="Deception" />}}
[[File:SwiftDies-TheDroidDeception.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Swift and their men are killed in battle.]]
Inside the security complex, [[Gorgol/Legends|Gorgol the Handy]], the station's chief [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]], watched as Swift and their [[Gender/Legends|men]] approached via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. To defend the bunker, Gorgol activated all the hidden [[Autoturret/Legends|blaster turrets]] protecting the complex. One of Swift's men alerted the sergeant to the [[Turret/Legends|turrets]], but Swift ordered their men to press on. The turrets overwhelmed the squadron, though, and [[Death/Legends|killed]] them all, much to Cody's shock. Windu stopped Cody from leaving cover, reminding<ref name="Deception" /> him<ref name="Pronouns">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> there was nothing he could do to help them.<ref name="Deception" />

Cody mourned the squadron, feeling responsible for their deaths, but Kenobi reassured him that a lesson had been learned. Cody, Kenobi, Ponds, and Windu gathered and formulated a plan to draw Gorgol out of the complex. After successfully luring Gorgol into the open, Cody used a [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] to shoot the remote control the mechanic used to operate the turrets, allowing the Jedi to [[Prisoner/Legends|arrest]] him. Kenobi informed Cody that<ref name="Deception" /> he<ref name="Pronouns" /> was proud of him for showing restraint in light of the deaths of his men, including Swift. The commander confessed that he had indeed aimed for Gorgol's head, but the [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] always pulled to the right.<ref name="Deception" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Sarge!'' Blaster turrets rising from the floor&hellip;''They're everywhere!"<br />"''Don't slow down! We have to reach the bunker before&mdash;|italics=0|A clone trooper and Sergeant Swift|<ref name="Deception" />}}
Swift was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] male clone.<ref name="Databank" /> They, like all other clones of Fett, had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin<ref name="Skin" /> and stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="Databank" /> Swift was committed to carrying out Cody's orders.<ref name="Deception" />

==Equipment==
During the raid on Tambor Station, the Sergeant wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with red markings. They also rode on an [[Walker/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transport]] and were equipped with thermal [[Detonator/Legends|detonators]].<ref name="Deception" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Swift appeared in "[[The Droid Deception]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.4|fourth issue of the sixth volume]] of the [[Star Wars Comic|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic]] magazine, which [[Titan Magazines]] published<ref name="Deception" /> on [[February 4]], [[2010]].<ref name="Parent release date">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/news20100129/index.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' UK Comic #6.4}}</ref> The story was written by [[Robin Etherington]] and illustrated by [[Andres Ponce]].<ref name="Deception" />
